item.title: Coco
item.description: Coco is an adorable puppy who’s still learning the basics. She’s very smart and eager to please, making her a great candidate for training.

item.title: Ruby
item.description: Ruby is an incredibly intelligent dog who loves to learn and work. She’s perfect for someone who enjoys training and wants a highly trainable companion.
